newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia PM calls special meeting on jobless.
newsitem.headline: Australia PM calls special meeting on jobless.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Tuesday he had called a special cabinet meeting for August to focus on Australia's stubbornly high unemployment rate.
"I think it is very important that we dedicate an entire cabinet day to discussing that issue, it is an enormously important issue," Howard told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio.
Howard did not say when the meeting would be held, but The Australian daily newspaper reported on Tuesday that it would take place on August 5.
Australia's unemployment rate has been stuck above 8.5 percent since Howard's conservative Liberal-National coalition was elected in March 1996.
Unemployment rose to 8.8 percent in May and economists are expecting the jobless rate to be 8.7 percent in June.
